Lift ice with a thread
Lift ice with a thread
Sprinkle a pinch of salt
on it,
and wait a couple
of minutes.
Now pull.
No knot, no glue.
Salt melts a thin layer
of ice,
and melting pulls heat
out of the cube.
The cube gets colder
than zero.
The meltwater dilutes
the salt,
and the cold cube
freezes the water around
the thread again.
With the thread inside.
Try it tonight.
